Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. Inline comments: Review comments at @bin/cr-full-review: - Line 144: Update the GraphQL query and export logic around `reviewThreads` so every comment in each thread is fetched and written, rather than requesting only `comments(first:1)` and printing only the first result. Paginate the nested thread comments independently of `reviewThreads` pagination, and preserve the existing export format for each comment. - Line 158: Update the `gh pr view` metadata handling in `bin/cr-full-review` to obtain the head-repository identity and reject cross-repository PRs before the close and branch-deletion steps; only delete `headRefName` when it belongs to `$REPO`. - Line 161: The cleanup loop over "$head" and "$base" currently stops when a ref deletion fails. Update its deletion handling so a confirmed absent ref counts as already deleted, both refs are always attempted, and other API errors remain failures. - Line 59: Update the repository-resolution logic using repo_of_url to read the origin push URL rather than its fetch URL, and reject multiple push destinations instead of selecting one ambiguously. Apply the same destination-selection rule to the related repository lookup. - Line 83: Update the name normalisation around name so generated review names do not create leading or consecutive dots in Git ref components. Before publication, validate each generated ref with git check-ref-format and prevent publishing any ref that fails validation. - Line 150: Update the export block’s output handling so it writes to a temporary file in the cache directory instead of truncating "$out" before the export completes. Rename the temporary file to "$out" only after all API requests and conversions succeed, and preserve the existing cache file if any step fails. - Line 109: Update the review-count assignment in the `gh api` command to aggregate reviews across all paginated results and produce one integer before assigning it to `n`. Preserve the existing filter for reviews by users whose login starts with `BOT`, so subsequent arithmetic checks receive a single count. After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr ```
